upstream.name: Ember – Yearly Electricity Data (2026) and Yearly Electricity Data Europe (2026)

notes: Imported from data/raw/owid/owid_energy.csv, column "solar_electricity_twh", years 1990 on (one row per country and year; the latest year with a value is shown, the full series is kept for charts and derived datasets).

Codebook (data/raw/owid/owid_energy.codebook.csv) title: "Electricity generation from solar power"; unit: "terawatt-hours (TWh)"; sources: Ember – Yearly Electricity Data Europe (2026); Ember – Yearly Electricity Data (2026); Energy Institute – Statistical Review of World Energy (2026); Pinto et al. – Global historical electricity (2023).

Rows with a blank iso_code are matched by their "country" name: Kosovo -> XKX; regions, income groups and source-defined aggregates (e.g. "Europe (EI)", "G20 (Ember)", "World") and former states are skipped. A blank cell is kept as missing, never 0.

scoring.rationale: Context: describes the electricity system, not dependence on its own; used as an input or shown next to the scored import exposure.
